title: Kindling: first trailer (claude code generated trailer)
author: Kale_Elements
selftext:
Hi, so I've been working on Kindling for past few months (I started it a year ago and then stopped after 3 months of developing and 2 months ago I continued with claude code - 20€ plan).  Here is short ai generated trailer for my game.

Kindling is yet another one of deckbuilding roguelike games, but my twist is that fights are using quick time events to perform spells. Also since I use all the spells before ending turn to cast them, i also have plenty of cards synergies and combos for player to explore and learn. For now i offer 2 play styles, if you want 3d world where you can run around and explore the world while finding cards and fights and bosses and if not, there is nodes system, where you just press next node, whichever you want and instantly go to that spot, you don't have to fight every fight like in sts, you can move around almost freely even on nodes map.

Also I'll be working on easier mode of game where Quick time events won't be a must (for example you will just queue cards and press end turn and they will all play alone, it is easy mode and for players who aren't confident in their keyboard skills enough, also it will be mode that will go into mobile version of the game one day also).

So this project still has lots of things to do, I would say it is half done only because now I'm in the phase where I playtest a lot and polish it. Feel free to give me your feedback!

Thank you for your time!
